tagline: All 118 elements, and a quiz you can race a friend on.
description:
All 118 live on this device. Tap a cell: the table stays put, a card fills with the name, number, mass, family and electrons. Filter alkali metals, noble gases, the rest. Make the cells bigger and pan if you want to read the map itself.

Test yourself: what is the symbol for Gold? Which of these is a noble gas? Four choices, one right. Misses show up at the end. Your best score is saved.

Quiz a friend from one link: open A friend, then Invite in the bar above the app, and send it. You both get the same questions and race to ten right.

An unofficial port of Periodic Table by calebephrem. This copy adds the race from one invite.
